temporary_siphon: temporary attribute points return to target when duration ends unless converted under a valid permanent mechanism

fragments.source: rare residue from successful Stat Siphon against meaningful resistance
limits: maximum one permanent conversion per seven in-world days
cannot convert while CM instability is above mild
conversion consumes 40 CM and requires eight hours recovery
target does not suffer permanent loss from routine fragment generation

anti_abuse: Repeated siphoning of the same willing target under safe conditions produces no fragments.
